versions.title: 拖進長譜檔，畫面不再卡住
items: 拖入或開啟較大的 MIDI / MusicXML，解碼與譜面換算改在背景進行，畫面不會再卡住約一秒
兩萬個音的檔案，最長的一次卡頓從約 1.07 秒降到約 0.35 秒（四倍降速模擬）
五百到兩千個音的一般譜檔也比較不會卡，開譜時間還變短了一點
譜面會在換算完成的那一刻出現，不會再做第二次

en.title: Long imports no longer freeze the page
items: Dropping or opening a larger MIDI / MusicXML now decodes and converts in the background, so the screen stops freezing for about a second
For a 20,000-note file the worst single stall drops from about 1.07 s to about 0.35 s in a 4x-slowdown simulation
Ordinary imports of 500 to 2,000 notes stall less too, and open slightly sooner
The sheet appears the moment its conversion lands, instead of being built a second time

versions.title: 選完曲子更快聽到第一個音
items: 從選好曲子到聽到第一個音，等待時間縮短約三分之一
9 MB 的鋼琴音色改在頁面空閒時背景載入，不再卡在你按下播放的那一刻
換曲子不會重新載入音色，開第一首時也不會再凍結約 0.4 秒
進度列和時間數字不再每秒重繪 60 次，效能較差的裝置上掉幀少了約四分之一

en.title: The first note arrives sooner
items: The wait from picking a song to hearing the first note is about a third shorter
The 9 MB piano sound loads in the background while the page is idle, not when you press play
Switching songs no longer reloads the sound, and opening the first song no longer freezes the page for ~0.4s
The seek bar and time readout no longer repaint 60 times a second, for about a quarter fewer dropped frames on slower devices

versions.title: 曲庫多了 62 首教材小品
items: 新增「教材小品」：拜耳 24 首，適合剛開始用雙手彈的孩子
也有巴哈《安娜·瑪德蓮娜筆記本》、車爾尼、布格繆勒 25 首、小奏鳴曲和柴可夫斯基《兒童曲集》
克萊曼第小奏鳴曲現在三個樂章都能練，第一樂章也變成完整版
搜尋「拜耳」、「布格繆勒」或「小步舞曲」就找得到

en.title: 62 teaching pieces
items: New Teaching Pieces: 24 pieces from Beyer, made for first steps with both hands
Also Bach's Anna Magdalena Notebook, Czerny, Burgmüller's 25 Studies, sonatinas and Tchaikovsky's Children's Album
Clementi's Sonatina now has all three movements, and the first is complete
Search for Beyer, Burgmüller or minuet to find them

versions.title: 鋼琴自己會彈了，也換上新外觀
items: 接上藍牙鋼琴後，曲子會從鋼琴彈出來；等待模式只彈你沒在練的那一手
一個按鈕就能連鋼琴；在 iPad 上會告訴你怎麼用 Bluefy 打開
換成和顏色寶可夢一樣的外觀，可以選淺色、深色或跟著系統
右上角的 ⓘ 可以看更新紀錄，有新東西時會出現小紅點

en.title: The piano plays along, and a new look
items: With a Bluetooth piano connected, the song plays on the piano; in Wait mode it only plays the hand you're not practising
One button connects the piano; on iPad, Rexiano shows how to open it in Bluefy
A new look shared with our other games, in light, dark, or following the system
The ⓘ at the top shows what's new, with a red dot when there's something you haven't seen

versions.title: 變成網頁版了
items: 打開瀏覽器就能練琴，不用再安裝
可以安裝成 App，沒有網路也能練
匯入的曲子會留在瀏覽器裡，下次直接打開

en.title: Rexiano is now a web app
items: Practice right in the browser — nothing to install
Install it as an app to practice offline
Imported songs stay in the browser so you can reopen them
